title: Jewel Toned Molten Irish Rice Pilaf
description: A floral and molten Irish dish featuring rice, syrup, and jocheong, made with dairy-free friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection on a comal.
instructions: Preheat the comal over medium heat and brush with comal oil to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl, mix together the Irish rice, jocheong, dried lavender buds, salt, and monsoon spice mix.
Add the coconut milk to the bowl and stir until the rice is well coated.
Spoon the rice mixture onto the preheated comal and cook for 5 minutes on the first side.
Flip the rice mixture over and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted and fragrant.
Remove the comal from the heat and let the rice pilaf rest for 2 minutes.
Garnish with fresh rose petals and serve hot.
Traditionally, this dish is served during the monsoon season, but it can be enjoyed year-round.
